newsitem.title: INDIA: India introduces women's quota bill in parliament.
newsitem.headline: India introduces women's quota bill in parliament.

text.p: The Indian government introduced legislation on Friday to reserve a third of seats in the lower house and state assemblies for women, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
Parliament deputies, including members from the ruling Janata Dal party, had tried to prevent Prime Minister I.K. Gujral from presenting the bill, PTI said.
Janata Dal parliamentary leader Sharad Yadav told the lower house that deputies felt the bill was being rushed through in defiance of their "very strong" objections.
Yadav complained that the bill would not set aside seats for low-caste women and minorities.
Law Minister Ramakant Khalap managed to introduce the legislation later but discussion was deferred until the next session of parliament in November.
